answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lagoon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
